title: Reactions and comments UI
goal: Members can react to and comment on any transcript message or agent card in the TUI, with pixel reactions at 24 px equivalents, per-person limits and comments that stay end-to-end encrypted.
scope_in: Reaction bar and thread components in packages/tui/src/reactions/: picker (thumbs, heart, party, laugh plus eyes and check), reaction summary row per target, count per code, own reactions highlighted.
Send/remove logic: `reaction {target, code, op: add|remove}` as a clear event; enforce max 3 reactions per person per message client-side and de-dupe by (member,target,code).
Comments: `comment.add {target, text}` as an encrypted event, thread view under a message, composer limited to 64 KiB text (schema maxLength 65536 chars; UI cap 2 000 chars).
Viewer-role support: viewers may react and comment (CT-RBAC); other actions stay hidden.
Mascot mapping reaction codes -> animations reaction_thumbs, reaction_heart, reaction_party, reaction_laugh through the state driver; eyes/check render a glyph only.
scope_out: Transcript virtualised view (C036) and the widget that hosts the reaction bar's anchor.
Web reactions/comments UI (C083 renders them from the same reducer).
Reducer for incoming frames into GuestState (C076) and host broadcast (C075).
build_against: Fixtures contracts/fixtures/events/reaction.json and comment.add.json, a fake session handle exposing send(), and the TUI snapshot tester (C008).
interfaces: export function ReactionBar(props: {target: MsgId; reactions: ReactionSummary[]; selfMember: MemberId; canReact: boolean; onToggle(code: ReactionCode): void}): JSX.Element
export function CommentThread(props: {target: MsgId; comments: CommentView[]; canComment: boolean; onAdd(text: string): Promise<void>}): JSX.Element
export function reduceReactions(state: ReactionState, frame: DecodedFrame): ReactionState  // handles reaction add/remove idempotently by frame id
acceptance: Toggling a code sends exactly one `reaction` frame with op add (or remove if already set) and `t:"event"`; optimistic UI reverts if the echo does not arrive within 5 s.
A fourth distinct reaction by the same member on one target is blocked locally with a toast; no frame sent.
Two clients adding the same reaction concurrently show count 2 on both after convergence; replaying a frame with the same id does not double count.
A viewer sees the picker and comment composer; a muted member sees them disabled with the reason text 'Muted by host'.
Comment text is sent only inside `ct`; the outgoing `p` for comment.add is empty or absent (asserted by test); a 2 001-character input is rejected inline with a helper message.
Unknown reaction code from a newer client is shown as a generic glyph with the count, not dropped.
Reaction animation plays at most once per received reaction and at most 3 concurrently; under CENTO_REDUCE_MOTION it is a static glyph.
tests: reactions.reduce.test.ts: add/remove/dup/unknown code with property test for commutativity.
guardrails: MUST put comment text only in `ct`; MUST NOT log it.
MUST NOT use emoji as the display (emoji are picker icons only); display is pixel glyph/animation per DESIGN.md 12.7, always paired with a text count for screen readers.
MUST NOT show read receipts or reaction notifications to people who did not opt in (DESIGN.md 12.8).
Reaction and comment sends MUST respect the 30 sequenced frames/s per-member limit; client token bucket drops UI spam, never queues unboundedly (cap 20).
failure_modes: sys.error `forbidden` on send (role changed) -> revert optimistic state and disable controls.
Target message not yet loaded -> hold reaction in a pending map up to 60 s, drop afterwards.
Frame rate limit sys.slow_down -> pause sending for `for_ms`, keep the latest toggle only.
notes: DESIGN.md lists 4 reaction animations; the schema also allows eyes and check, which have no mascot animation (glyph only).
